shortcuts.title: Shortcuts and gestures
shortcuts.intro: Everything you can do on the board with the mouse and keyboard.
shortcuts.marquee: Draw a box to pick several tables.
shortcuts.addRemove: Add or remove one table from the selection.
shortcuts.groupDrag: Drag one and every selected table follows.
shortcuts.snap: They line up with neighbouring tables on their own.
shortcuts.nudge: Nudge the selection step by step.
shortcuts.nudgeFine: With Shift, one pixel at a time.
shortcuts.pan: Move the canvas without the scrollbars.
shortcuts.zoom: Zoom in or out around the cursor.
shortcuts.addHere: Add a table right where you double-clicked.
shortcuts.contextMenu: Open the table's or selection's menu.
